LESSON: VEGETATION IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Vegetation in Eastern Africa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Vegetation in Eastern Africa. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How can we conserve vegetation in our environment?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main types of vegetation in Eastern Africa on a map
2. draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main types of vegetation
3. describe the characteristics of the main types of vegetation in Eastern Africa

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the main types of vegetation in Eastern Africa on a map
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the main types of vegetation in Eastern Africa on a map. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main types of vegetation
   In simple words: practise until you can draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main types of vegetation. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. describe the characteristics of the main types of vegetation in Eastern Africa
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the characteristics of the main types of vegetation in Eastern Africa. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Vegetation in Eastern Africa using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Vegetation in Eastern Africa in the examples.
2. Explain Vegetation in Eastern Africa to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Vegetation in Eastern Africa.
4. Show that you can: identify the main types of vegetation in Eastern Africa on a map

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Vegetation in Eastern Africa using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Vegetation in Eastern Africa important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Draw a map of Eastern Africa indicating the main types of vegetation and display the map class,
2. Discuss the characteristics of the main types of vegetation in Eastern Africa,
3. Critical thinking and problem solving: Learners follow instructions to locate the main vegetation types in Eastern Africa using digital devices.
4. Environmental education: Learners practise environmental awareness as they plan and write down, in groups, how they will conserve vegetation within the school compound.
5. Patriotism: Learners demonstrate patriotism as they plan and carry out activities on conservation of vegetation in their locality. Values:

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the main types of vegetation in Eastern Africa on a map
2. draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main types of vegetation
3. describe the characteristics of the main types of vegetation in Eastern Africa

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
